cards.explanation: The answer is False. God picks the mountain. He says, “…one of the mountains, which I will show you.” Abraham doesn't choose the spot, God does the showing. Friends, I've been handed a "trust me" before, but never one this big.

The answer is that he splits the wood for the offering. Verse 3 says Abraham saddles the donkey, takes the servants and Isaac, and splits the wood for a burnt offering. Then he sets out for the place God had designated. Notice he's up early the next morning, before any of it happens.

The answer is True. Abraham tells his servants, “Stay here with the donkey…” Then he says, “The boy and I will go over there to worship, and then we will return to you.” The servants stay put and the donkey keeps them company. That's the plan he gives them in verse 5, friends.

The answer is knife. Abraham carries the fire and the sacrificial knife himself. Isaac gets the wood, and Abraham keeps the fire and the knife. Then comes the line that's easy to miss, friends: the two of them walk on together.

The answer is that Isaac asks where the lamb for the offering is. Isaac says, “The fire and the wood are here…” and then he asks, “but where is the lamb for the burnt offering?” He names what they have and then asks about what's missing. I think it's a very honest question, friends.

The answer is that God Himself will provide the lamb. Abraham says, “God Himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son.” That's his whole answer to Isaac, and he ends it with “my son.” Then verse 8 says the two walked on together.
The answer is altar. Abraham builds the altar there and arranges the wood. It's built right on the spot God had designated. Nobody hands him a ready-made one, friends.

The answer is True. In verse 1 God calls “Abraham!” and he answers, “Here I am…” In verse 11 the angel of the LORD calls “Abraham, Abraham!” and he answers, “Here I am…” Same answer, even with the knife in his hand, friends. He also says it to Isaac in verse 7.

The answer is that the angel says, “Do not lay a hand on the boy or do anything to him…” It's a clear stop, and it comes right when the knife is in Abraham's hand. I think this is where everybody finally breathes, friends.

The answer is fears. The angel says, “for now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your only son from me.” Those are the angel's own words in verse 12. The word is fear, plain and simple, friends.

The answer is a ram caught by its horns. Verse 13 says Abraham looked up and saw behind him a ram in a thicket, caught by its horns. It was right there behind him, friends. Abraham just had to look up.

The answer is son. Verse 13 says Abraham took the ram and offered it as a burnt offering in place of his son. The ram takes Isaac's place on that altar. Abraham names the place The LORD Will Provide right after, friends.

The answer is False. It's not the heavens. The oath in verse 16 starts, “By Myself I have sworn, declares the LORD…” He swears by Himself, friends. The oath comes because Abraham has not withheld his only son.

The answer is the stars in the sky and the sand on the seashore. The LORD says He will multiply Abraham's descendants “…like the stars in the sky and the sand on the seashore.” Both are beyond counting, friends. I'm a bit of a star expert myself, since every finished cookie box lights one up in my sky.

The answer is True. The LORD says, “And through your offspring all nations of the earth will be blessed, because you have obeyed My voice.” That's a big promise in verse 18, friends. All nations, not just one.
